title: Sucks
text: Sucks. It sucks up fur really well. I don’t navigate exactly how I would like (like the memory) but for the price I would say it’s good.

product_metadata.title: ZCWA Robot Vacuum Cleaner, Robotic Vacuum and Mop Combo Compatible with Alexa/WiFi/App, Self-Charging, 230ML Water Tank for Pet Hair, Hard Floors and Low Pile Carpet (Navy-Blue)
features: [2-In-1 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo] Mopping Robot Vacuum with 1400Pa suction tackles dirt, debris, and pet hair more quickly and effectively on hardwood, tile, laminate, and low pile carpet. A Wet mop function cleans your home more thoroughly.

[Smart App & Voice Control] Via Tuya Smart App to set the home cleaning schedule, modes, suction level, etc. The auto vacuum robot is also compatible with Alexa and Google Assistant making it possible to clean your home with simple voice commands. For convenience, the remote control is also included in the package, you can choose the control method. (2.4GHz Wi-Fi Only)

[Slim, Flexible, and Powerful] The 2.87inch slim design helps the robot vacuum get freely in and out of beds, sofas, and more to clean every corner and tight space. Equipped with infrared sensors for evading obstacles and drop-sensing technology to avoid falls, the Robot vacuum can intelligently identify and avoid white walls, stairs, toys, and obstacles.

[Long-Lasting Battery Life] With a battery capacity of 2500mAh, the robot vacuum cleaner can work continuously for 100 minutes in a 1290m² house and automatically return to the charging base and charge itself when the battery is low or cleaning is finished. The runtime is affected by the cleaning mode and floor type.

[4 High-Efficiency Cleaning Modes] This robot vacuum cleaner can flexibly switch 4 cleaning modes through the remote control/APP, including Auto, Spot, Edge, and Zig-zag cleaning. You can customize the cleaning program for a better cleaning effect, below 65dB noise will not disturb your family in any mode.
